This document outlines the equipment inspection check list I1 which must be 
performed an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block. 
for the TL High Dam / Nag Hamady cct no. 1

The first draft is initiated by eng. Alaa el-deen 
Sakr, tested by eng. Gamal hassan, accepted by eng. Badr Ibrahem Abdel Gawad 
general director, and approved by eng. Abdel Karem Abu Zied Ismaiel; Head Sector 
of High Dam Hydraulic Power Station, and certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem 
HPGC inspection and quality control general director.

A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety id category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.
Switch off the CB`s (B-L1) - II, B-L2 - II)
Switch off the disconnector 500 kv reactor (PP-L1)
Connect the earth of reactor 500 kv (Z-P-L1)
Disconnect the automatic (MCB) of voltage transformer of reactor
Put the gas relay jumper on alarm position (or out of work)
Close fire manual valves of reactor
Presence industrial safety supervisor during washing

أعدّ المسودة الأولى م. Alaa el-deen Sakr، واختبرها م. Gamal hassan، وقبلها م. Badr Ibrahem Abdel Gawad المدير العام، واعتمدها م. Abdel Karem Abu Zied Ismaiel؛ رئيس قطاع محطة السد العالي الكهرومائية، وصدّق عليها م. Kamel Ragheb Hakem المدير العام للتفتيش ومراقبة الجودة بشركة HPGC.
يجب إصدار تصريح عمل، ويجب أن يحمل طاقم الصيانة المؤهل فئة السلامة المناسبة.
يجب تسييج منطقة العمل بحبل وشريط تحذيري حولها.
